name: ✨ Feature Request

title: '[FEAT] '

## ✨ Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves

What problem does this feature address? Who benefits from it?

> Example: *"As a user practicing for technical interviews, I find it difficult to review my past sessions because there's no playback feature."*

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## 📸 Mockups / Examples (optional)

Add any mockups, wireframes, or examples from other apps.

## 📊 Impact

- **Who benefits:** [e.g. all users / power users / developers]
- **Complexity estimate:** [Low / Medium / High]
- **Priority:** [Nice-to-have / Important / Critical]

## 📝 Additional Context

Any other context about the feature request.
